topic: Why drinking cold water doesn't stop the burn of spicy food, and what does
title: Why Ice Water Won't Stop the Spicy Burn (But Milk Will)
false_sentence: Drinking cold water makes spicy food burn worse.
correct_version: Capsaicin, the chemical behind the burn, dissolves in fat and oil, not water. Cold water only cools the mouth for a moment and can spread the capsaicin around; milk, yogurt or other fatty foods actually pick it up and carry it away.
why: Water does not make the burn chemically worse; it just fails to wash the oily capsaicin away.
